canonical_api.output_contract: out_maze is reset to NULL before validation and receives caller ownership only on success

algorithm.lattice: odd/odd logical cells with a blocked one-cell perimeter
algorithm.kill: Fisher-Yates shuffle of four directions followed by the first unvisited valid neighbor
algorithm.hunt: first row-major unvisited logical cell adjacent to the tree, with one uniformly selected visited attachment neighbor
algorithm.progress: each carve adds one unvisited logical vertex and one tree edge
algorithm.postcondition: visited logical cell count equals logical width times logical height
algorithm.replay: same extent and seed preserve the Stage 1 raster hash

validation.dimensions: width and height are odd and at least 3
validation.bounds: the inclusive last coordinate must fit int32_t
validation.max_steps: one step per kill/hunt outer iteration; default is raster cells times 16
validation.cancellation: polled before generation, throughout raster materialization, and for each hunt candidate
validation.exception_barrier: bad_alloc maps to OUT_OF_MEMORY; other exceptions map to CORRUPT_STATE
validation.failure_atomicity: partial Maze output is never published

wrapper.native_policy_test: 7/7 maze wrapper policy tests passed against the current MSVC Release DLL
wrapper.generation_check: generated CFFI declarations are up to date

verification.sdk_consumer: clean-install C17 and C++17 consumers built and ran successfully
verification.header_abi_audit: 150 headers, 95 public C headers, 1166 declarations, 0 invariant errors
verification.stage1_topology: 100-seed perfect-maze and narrow logical-grid corpus remains active
